snippet.title: ₹5,675 Crore vs ₹56.75 Crore: Adani’s Tarali Project Controversy
snippet.description:
Adani Green Energy’s 1,500 MW Tarali pumped storage project in Satara, Maharashtra, is facing questions over its declared cost and wildlife conservation contribution. 🔍

According to The Indian Express, a cost revision from ₹5,675 crore to ₹56.75 crore reduced the calculated 4% conservation contribution from ₹227 crore to ₹2.27 crore. The Centre ordered an investigation into the matter.

Adani disputes allegations of reducing its obligations, saying ₹56.75 crore represents only site investigation and survey expenses—not the full project cost.

This video explains the reported figures and their implications for wildlife conservation around Koyna Wildlife Sanctuary and Sahyadri Tiger Reserve.

Source: The Indian Express investigation, November 13, 2026.
Company response: Adani Green Energy statement, November 13, 2026.

snippet.title: Never Doubt The Mind of Narendra Modi! #shorts
snippet.description:
Never Doubt The Mind of Narendra Modi! #shorts 

Congress supporters and social media critics thought they had found another “Aloo Sona” moment when Narendra Modi spoke about farmers testing soil through mobile-based technology. Memes followed, with many questioning how a phone could possibly analyse soil.

But the technology Modi was referring to is not imaginary. It is called Bhu-Parikshak, a portable soil testing device developed by IIT Kanpur.

The handheld device uses Near-Infrared Spectroscopy to analyse a small soil sample and estimate important soil properties and nutrient levels. Based on the analysis, it can also provide fertiliser recommendations to help farmers make more informed decisions.

So, what exactly is Bhu-Parikshak? How does this technology work? And why did a statement about soil testing become another political meme battle?

In this video, we break down the science behind Modi Ji’s remark and the technology that many social media critics appeared to have missed.

トマトピューレ　100g

砂糖　　　　　　小さじ1/4

使用フライパン内径18cm

〈作り方〉
①じゃがいも皮をむき
　芽があればしっかり取り除く

②菜麺器にじゃがいもを差し込み
　トゲの部分で固定して
　ハンドルを回しながら細長くカットする
※中心に残ったきのこ型のじゃがいもも
　捨てずに揚げる
（菜麺器がない場合はスライサーなどで
　せん切りでも代用可）

③ボウルにポティト麺とお塩を入れて
　全体にお塩をなじませる

④油大さじ1をフライパンにひろげ
　ポティトを入れて厚さを均一に整えてから
　弱めの中火で着火

⑤ 3-4分焼いたらヘラでまわりを整えて
　6分くらい焼いたらフライパンゆすって
　焼きムラないようにポテポジを変える

⑥ じ〜っくり焼いて（動画は12分焼きました）
　ええ感じの焼き色ついてきたら
　ひっくり返して鍋肌から油大さじ1を投入
　
⑦ 裏面も7-8分焼いてこんがりキツネの
　ええ色になったらバターを加えて
　ポティトにバラーしみこんだらできあがり

⑧ソースは小鍋にトマトピューレ、お水
　砂糖、おろしにんにくをいれて一煮立ちさせ
　弱火で時々混ぜながら3〜4分グツグツ

⑨ お味噌をダマにならんように
　溶いてから加えたら火止めてバターを投入し
　お塩で整えたらソースの完成

마지막에 돌아온 ‘언니가 걱정된다’는 말마저, 여진을 보호하기보다 비밀을 말하지 못하게 만드는 힘으로 바뀐다는 점이 섬뜩하게 남습니다.

That’s a total of 43 KG of delicious street food! 🤯
